moonbit.note: Upstream publishes no signed checksums; pins are observed values verified in CI before execution. Versioned objects expire (~60 days), so expiry fails loudly and requires a deliberate re-pin.

versions.note: Oracle candidates are pinned inputs, not execution evidence. Missing exact commits/toolchain/OS keep M0 open. CI toolchain bootstrap is not a compatibility pin.

rows.scope: CJS resolution and immutable source inventory
rows.gap: Runtime-owned facade declares the app surface; not an Electron compatibility proof or a real packaged app run.

MoonBit lifecycle drives the facade and a real socketpair probe; a core-owned differential compares the unchanged oracle fixture on both runtimes and diverges at ipcMain.on. No native host or BrowserWindow API.

Probe verdict NO_PUBLIC_SYNC_PROXY: cross-world function references are undefined, messageHandlers/evaluateJavaScript are async, the sync DOM-event channel carries no callables or throws, JS dialogs are a page-visible native surface (prompt dead on this build), and sync XHR to a URL-scheme handler is string-only. Synchronous bridge remains unresolved; the differential run aborts at ipcMain.on before preload or contextBridge execute.
Bounded tree codec and request ledger, not ipcRenderer/ipcMain implementations; the facade rejects ipcMain.on with ELECTRON_MBT_UNSUPPORTED_API during module evaluation.
No native sender-attestation adapter; caller-supplied metadata is not authentication.
